subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: After recovery cannot establish the original accepted run’s terminal outcome, should `openclaw agent` preserve automatic fresh-session embedded fallback or fail closed unless the user explicitly opts into rerun?
rationale: Both outcomes intentionally trade off continuity against duplicate side effects and delivery; source-level correctness cannot choose that user-facing policy.

options.title: Preserve automatic isolated fallback
options.body: Recover first, then retain the current automatic fresh-session fallback when recovery is exhausted so existing CLI callers still receive a result.

options.title: Fail closed by default
options.body: Return an unknown-outcome error unless the caller explicitly opts into rerun, minimizing duplicate side effects at the cost of changed CLI continuity.

options.title: Split by invocation mode
options.body: Use a distinct policy for `--deliver` and interactive stdout paths if maintainers want different continuity and duplicate-delivery tradeoffs.

recommendation.title: Preserve automatic isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Recover first, then retain the current automatic fresh-session fallback when recovery is exhausted so existing CLI callers still receive a result.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged current-main containment work establishes the affected fallback boundary, making this the strongest available routing signal.
